description: This file contains unit tests for the Comment class in the Goteo project, specifically testing the creation, validation, and deletion of comments on blog posts.

classes.name: CommentTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Comment-related functionalities in Goteo blog post comments.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Comment class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validate and save methods on the Comment object.

methods.name: testCreatePost
methods.description: Creates and validates a Post object for testing.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Creates a comment associated with a post and tests save, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving and deleting a non-existent comment.

methods.name: tearDownAfterClass
methods.description: Cleans up the database by deleting the post created during tests and removes test user.
